designationHistory.indexText: Conboy Lake National Wildlife Refuge in south-central Washington was authorized by the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission in 1964 and established in 1965 with the purchase of the 920-acre Dilling Tract.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Migratory Bird Conservation Act)

designationHistory.note: FWS only. The CCP gives 1964 (Commission authorization) and 1965 (first purchase) and in one passage says the refuge was established in 1964.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Conboy Lake NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2014 (ServCat 111177)
